reading.title: Too Loud in the Library
reading.intro_zh: 这篇短文不复述剧院里的争执，而是换到现代图书馆自习区：两位同学聊的是私人事情，但音量太大，仍然打扰了共享空间里的其他人。重点回收 private / conversation / seat / loudly / pay attention / angry / rudely / none of your business，并把社交边界讲清楚。
passage: Last Friday I went to the library after school. I had a very good seat near the window, and I wanted to finish my science notes. Two students sat behind me and began a private conversation about a birthday party. At first I tried to pay attention to my work, but they were talking loudly. Other readers looked at them, but they did not stop. I turned round and gave them a polite reminder. One student answered rudely, "It's none of your business." I felt angry, but I did not shout. I told the librarian instead. She explained that a library is a shared space. A conversation may be private, but loud voices are still public.

questions.question: Where did the shared-space problem happen?
options: In a library after school.
In a theatre during a play.
On a noisy bus.
At a birthday party.
questions.explanation_zh: 短文开头说 Last Friday I went to the library after school，问题发生在图书馆。

questions.question: What made the private conversation disturb other people?
options: The students were talking loudly in a quiet shared space.
The students were writing science notes.
The narrator chose a seat near the window.
The librarian closed the library early.
questions.explanation_zh: 他们聊的是 private conversation，但 they were talking loudly，所以打扰了共享空间里的其他人。

questions.question: How did the narrator first react?
options: The narrator tried to pay attention to the work.
The narrator shouted at the students at once.
The narrator left the library immediately.
The narrator joined the conversation.
questions.explanation_zh: 文中说 At first I tried to pay attention to my work，说明叙述者一开始先努力专心。

questions.question: Why was "It's none of your business" not acceptable here?
options: Because the students' loud voices affected people in a shared space.
Because nobody is allowed to have a birthday party.
Because the narrator wanted to know their secret.
Because libraries never allow students to sit together.
questions.explanation_zh: 对话内容可以是私人的，但声音影响了别人，就不只是“与你无关”的问题了。

questions.question: What is the social lesson of the story?
options: Private content still needs public manners.
A private conversation should always be louder.
It is rude to ask a librarian for help.
A good seat makes every problem disappear.
questions.explanation_zh: 结尾点明：A conversation may be private, but loud voices are still public。私人内容也需要公共礼貌。

writing.intro_zh: 今天的句式仿写围绕 Lesson 1 的冲突推进：先写一个很好的位置，再写别人不理会提醒，接着写自己忍到极限，最后理解一句很冲的边界话。注意：none of your business 很直接，仿写时要知道语气，不要随便用来怼人。

patterns.title: I had a very good ...
patterns.source: I had a very good seat.
patterns.focus_zh: 用 I had a very good ... 先建立一个好的期待，再让后面的麻烦形成反差。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：你在电影院、教室、图书馆或比赛现场有一个很好的位置。
patterns.sample: I had a very good seat near the window.
patterns.tip_zh: had a very good 后面接具体名词，比如 seat, place, view。

patterns.title: did not pay any attention
patterns.source: They did not pay any attention.
patterns.focus_zh: 用 did not pay any attention 写别人没有理会提醒、眼神或规则。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：有人没有理会老师、同学、家长或公共提示。
patterns.sample: The two boys did not pay any attention to the sign.
patterns.tip_zh: 后面常接 to，再写被忽视的人、提醒或标志。

patterns.title: In the end, I could not ...
patterns.source: In the end, I could not bear it.
patterns.focus_zh: 用 In the end, I could not ... 表示事情持续了一段时间后，终于到了忍耐极限。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：你一开始忍着，最后实在不能继续忍受某件事。
patterns.sample: In the end, I could not finish my homework in the noise.
patterns.tip_zh: In the end 放句首后加逗号；could not 后面接动词原形。

patterns.title: It's none of your business
patterns.focus_zh: 这句话表示“这不关你的事”，语气很硬。适合理解冲突中的无礼回应，不适合随便对朋友或老师说。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：在一个小故事里写出这句无礼回应，并让读者看出为什么它不合适。
patterns.sample: He said, "It's none of your business," but his loud music kept everyone awake.
patterns.tip_zh: 可以放在引号里当人物原话；后半句说明它为什么 rude。
